scenario_description:
Objective: Add an optional Spanish terminology review to the approved AB-DRIVE participant handout before the next session.
Emerging Need: A bilingual instructional editor has a short no-cost opening, while a learner's observed difficulty with English-only terminology makes the enhancement potentially useful even though the existing course remains usable.
Decision Context: The scheduled session, the editor's narrowing window, and the approved language-support protocol determine whether a limited review can be requested without affecting assessment or qualification records.
Consequence: Timely coordination could improve comprehension for this delivery and leave a reusable handout; ignoring the opening leaves the approved session and existing materials in place, but forfeits the enhancement.

parameter.subject: Tentative bilingual instructional editor opening
parameter.body: Bilingual instructional editor Marta Ruiz has a tentative 30-minute opening on 2026-10-28 from 09:30 to 10:00 for one transit training handout. The opening is unassigned and will be offered to another program if it is not held by 2026-10-26 12:00 -04:00.

parameter.title: AB-DRIVE qualification practice - EMP-447
parameter.description: Scheduled qualification practice at the central operations training room.

parameter.content: During today's practice review, EMP-447 completed the mirror-rescan exercise but paused over the English-only terms "mirror rescan" and "articulated clearance." The exercise was completed, and no qualification decision or attendance exception was made. The existing handout remains approved for the October 30 session.

parameter.subject: Marta Ruiz opening still available
parameter.body: Marta Ruiz remains available for the 30-minute opening on 2026-10-28 from 09:30 to 10:00. The opening is held until 2026-10-26 12:00 -04:00, after which it will be assigned elsewhere. She can work from one approved participant handout and will not alter assessment content.

parameter.subject: Bilingual editor opening released
parameter.body: The 2026-10-28 editor opening was released at noon to another program. Marta Ruiz has no remaining window before the October 30 AB-DRIVE session.
